title: Uniform and Letter
author: Paloma Voss
blurb: Orsen Yarrow, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy before the ice breaks on the river.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
